choices.why: A light ash desk with tapered legs and a small drawer is Nordic and fits the window wall without crowding, and its tone matches the floor.
A light birch bentwood swivel chair on casters is comfortable and matches the desk's pale wood, while its white base keeps it airy.
A tall, slim white bookcase blends into the white wall on the right and holds many books without taking much floor space.
A light birch bentwood rocking armchair with a cream cushion is cozy and Nordic, and it matches the pale woods.
A slim aluminium reading lamp with an adjustable head gives focused light beside the armchair and takes little space.

answer.why: Birch and ash tones, white and cream, and slim metal accents form a bright Nordic set that matches the wood floor and white walls. The desk and chair sit at the window, and the tall white bookcase blends into the right wall. The armchair and reading lamp complete the corner.
